text.KJV: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
text.ASV: The elder unto Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
text.WEB: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

text.KJV: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
text.ASV: Beloved, I pray that in all things thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
text.WEB: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

text.KJV: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
text.ASV: For I rejoiced greatly, when brethren came and bare witness unto thy truth, even as thou walkest in truth.
text.WEB: For I rejoiced greatly, when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

text.KJV: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
text.ASV: Greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth.
text.WEB: I have no greater joy than this, to hear about my children walking in truth.

text.KJV: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
text.ASV: Beloved, thou doest a faithful work in whatsoever thou doest toward them that are brethren and strangers withal;
text.WEB: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

text.KJV: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
text.ASV: who bare witness to thy love before the church: whom thou wilt do well to set forward on their journey worthily of God:
text.WEB: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

text.KJV: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
text.ASV: because that for the sake of the Name they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
text.WEB: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

text.KJV: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
text.ASV: We therefore ought to welcome such, that we may be fellow-workers for the truth.
text.WEB: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

text.KJV: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
text.ASV: I wrote somewhat unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
text.WEB: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

text.KJV: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
text.ASV: Therefore, if I come, I will bring to remembrance his works which he doeth, prating against us with wicked words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and them that would he forbiddeth and casteth `them' out of the church.
text.WEB: Therefore if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, neither does he himself receive the brothers, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

text.KJV: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
text.ASV: Beloved, imitate not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
text.WEB: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

text.KJV: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
text.ASV: Demetrius hath the witness of all `men', and of the truth itself: yea, we also bear witness: and thou knowest that our witness is true.
text.WEB: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

text.KJV: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
text.ASV: I had many things to write unto thee, but I am unwilling to write `them' to thee with ink and pen:
text.WEB: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

text.KJV: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
text.ASV: but I hope shortly to see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace `be' unto thee. The friends salute thee. Salute the friends by name.
text.WEB: but I hope to see you soon, and we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
[This verse is not included in this translation's manuscript tradition.]
